frozen_results: No model fitting, parameter changes, rescoring, seed selection or changes to any original benchmark result. New bibliographic synthesis is retrospective context only.
include_requirements: Primary document actually read or existing full primary review traceably reused
At least one autonomous deep neural comparator identifiable
Dataset,target,metrics and experimental protocol sufficiently described

scope: Post-hoc title/abstract screening of exactly620 provisional groups from834 supplied native export occurrences; not a new database search or retrospective replacement of earlier decisions.
screening_method: Every group receives an explicit agent-assisted title/abstract judgement. Ambiguous target or missing abstract advances to retrieval, not automatic rejection. target: Cryptocurrency realized or historical continuous volatility forecasting; implicit CVI, price-only forecasting, risk without volatility target and other markets are separate context/excluded from strict target corpus.
